title: ETCH Step: Chamber Pressure Excursion Investigation
trigger: chamber_pressure deviates > 2 sigma from nominal or Cpk < 1.33
procedures: 1. Issue soft PAUSE on ETCH tool via FDC interlock. Do not pull wafers.
2. Check throttle valve position vs. setpoint using APC (Advanced Process Control) log.
3. Inspect turbomolecular pump RPM log for stall events (< 89,000 RPM).
4. Perform manual pressure gauge cross-check with capacitance manometer.
5. If throttle valve lag > 50ms: schedule valve O-ring and seat inspection (PM-ETCH-THL-04).
6. If pump RPM normal: check foreline pressure for downstream restriction.
7. Run 2-wafer qualification lot at nominal pressure recipe before production restart.
8. Document in FDC event log under category ETCH-PRESSURE-DRIFT.
root_cause_precedents: 2024-Q1 ETCH-07 incident: throttle valve actuator backlash caused ±3.8 mTorr oscillation, producing edge-ring defects on 14 consecutive lots. Root cause: worn actuator gear. Fix: actuator replacement + recipe pressure ramp rate reduction to 0.5 mTorr/s.
2023-Q3 ETCH-12 incident: foreline N2 purge valve partial blockage caused 8 mTorr systematic offset. Spatial signature: uniform donut ring at wafer perimeter. Fix: foreline valve clean + 4-hour bake.

title: ETCH Step: RF Power / Impedance Matching Excursion
trigger: rf_power deviation > 2 sigma or etch rate drift > 5% from target
procedures: 1. Check RF generator reflected power ratio (target < 2% reflection coefficient).
2. Inspect RF match network capacitor position logs (C1, C2 setpoint vs. actual).
3. Run automatic RF match tune at 5-minute intervals — confirm convergence.
4. If match fails to converge: check RF cable connections at generator and chamber feedthrough.
5. Inspect chamber feedthrough for arcing marks (visual inspection requires tool venting).
6. Measure plasma uniformity using OES (Optical Emission Spectroscopy) if available.
7. Replace RF match network capacitors if tune offset > 15% from baseline (PM-ETCH-RF-07).
8. Post-repair: run 4-point wafer resistance uniformity check. Target: sigma < 2%.
root_cause_precedents: 2024-Q2 ETCH-07 RF incident: degraded RF match capacitor C2 caused 12% power loss at center, producing center-cluster oxide damage on 9 lots. Fix: C2 capacitor replacement, confirmed via 5-point etch rate map.
2023-Q4 ETCH-03 incident: RF cable sheath crack causing intermittent arcing. Signature: random defects with periodic intensity. Fix: cable replacement and regrounding.

title: LITHO Step: Focus Offset / CD Uniformity Excursion
procedures: 1. Run FEM (Focus Exposure Matrix) qualification wafer immediately.
2. Check lens barrel temperature log for thermal excursion > ±0.05°C.
3. Inspect reticle flatness via reticle inspection tool (AIMS or PROVE).
4. Verify chuck vacuum level and chuck flatness map (last calibration date).
5. Check stage leveling sensor (z-sensor) calibration — recalibrate if drift > 2nm.
6. If focus systematic across wafer (edge-ring): check wafer chuck leveling and vacuum seal.
7. If focus systematic at center: check lens thermal equilibration (30 min warm-up required after tool restart).
8. Perform 5-site CD-SEM measurement across suspect lot. Report mean+3sigma.
root_cause_precedents: 2024-Q1 LITHO-02 incident: reticle contamination (particle on pellicle) caused asymmetric focus signature — half-moon shadow pattern on wafer. Root cause confirmed by FEM + SEM cross-section. Fix: pellicle replacement.
2023-Q2 LITHO-05 incident: chuck vacuum leak caused wafer warp, producing donut-shaped focus deviation ring at 80% radius. Fix: chuck o-ring replacement and chuck flatness recalibration.

title: CVD Step: Gas Flow Deviation & Film Uniformity Excursion
trigger: gas_flow deviation > 3% of setpoint or film thickness sigma > 2%
procedures: 1. Check MFC (Mass Flow Controller) actual vs. setpoint log for all precursor and carrier gases.
2. Run MFC auto-zero and span calibration procedure (requires N2 span gas, SOP-CVD-MFC-01).
3. Inspect showerhead for particle deposits or blocked holes (visual via borescope — tool vented).
4. Verify chamber wall temperature profile — cold spot (< target - 10°C) causes edge non-uniformity.
5. Check exhaust throttle valve position for back-pressure creep.
6. Run 2-wafer seasoning recipe before production re-start after any gas system work.
7. Measure film thickness at 49 points using ellipsometry. Target: within-wafer sigma < 1.5%.
root_cause_precedents: 2024-Q3 CVD-04 incident: TiN precursor MFC drift caused 7% flow increase, resulting in thick donut ring at wafer center (over-deposition from center showerhead zone). Fix: MFC replacement + showerhead cleaning.
2023-Q1 CVD-08 incident: showerhead holes 12-15 blocked by process by-product, producing random high-density particle defects in affected zones. Fix: showerhead wet clean (H2O2/HF) and reinstall.

title: CMP Step: Removal Rate Uniformity & Scratch Defect Investigation
trigger: removal_rate deviation > 5% or scratch defect count > 10 per wafer
procedures: 1. Inspect polishing pad surface for glazing (use profilometer — target Ra > 5 μm).
2. Check slurry delivery system: flow rate, temperature (target 23°C ± 1°C), and pH (target 10.5 ± 0.2).
3. Inspect slurry dispense nozzle for clogging or crystallized slurry deposits.
4. Check conditioner disk wear rate and diamond grit condition (replace if wear > 50%).
5. Review wafer carrier pressure profile — edge exclusion zone pressure most critical.
6. If scratch pattern is radial: check for abrasive agglomeration in slurry (particle size > 500nm).
7. Run 2-wafer pad break-in lot before production restart after any pad change.
8. Post-measurement: 49-point film thickness map + defect review at 5 sites.
root_cause_precedents: 2024-Q2 CMP-02 incident: slurry abrasive agglomeration (colloidal silica size bimodal distribution) caused linear scratch defects on 18 lots. Fix: slurry line filter replacement (0.2 μm) + slurry reformulation.
2023-Q3 CMP-06 incident: pad glazing (low Ra = 2.1 μm) caused 30% removal rate drop and edge-ring under-polish. Fix: forced pad conditioning cycle + pad replacement at 2000-wafer count.

title: ION IMPLANT Step: Dose Uniformity & Beam Current Excursion
trigger: dose uniformity > 1.5% or beam current deviation > 2%
procedures: 1. Check beam current monitor log — compare actual vs. Faraday cup reference.
2. Verify end station scan uniformity: inspect scan motor encoder feedback for position error.
3. Inspect beam-defining aperture for charging or carbon build-up.
4. Check source arc current stability — should be < 0.5A variation over 30-minute window.
5. Verify neutralizer filament condition (replace if emission current < target by > 20%).
6. Run beam uniformity validation wafer (bare silicon, Faraday mapping). Target: sigma < 1%.
7. If edge-ring pattern: check wafer scan overshoot at edge turnaround positions.
8. Document in batch traveler and quarantine lot for 4-point probe measurement.
root_cause_precedents: 2024-Q1 IMPLANT-03 incident: neutralizer filament degradation caused beam charging, producing edge-ring pattern with 8% dose non-uniformity. Fix: neutralizer filament replacement + 2-hour beam conditioning.
2023-Q4 IMPLANT-07 incident: scan motor encoder noise caused systematic over-scan at left wafer edge, resulting in left-edge dose stripe. Fix: encoder cable replacement and scan table recalibration.
